theme: Split, aftermath, flashback, jump-start and board wipes
reuse: game/split.go (aftermath precedents: insult_injury.go, dusk_dawn.go); Flashback(); jump-start has NO helper — write it once as a flashback variant with a discard (siblings FlashbackSacrifice / FlashbackTap; CR 702.133) for Radical Idea, the only jump-start card; 'put target spell or nonland permanent into its owner's library second from the top': game/put_spell_in_library.go, oust.go; wipes: wrath_of_god.go ('can't be regenerated'), cycling trigger 'When you cycle this card' (Decree of Pain), convoke, adventure (Realm-Cloaked Giant).
